tools.name: sea_create
tools.title: Create a ticket
tools.description: Create one ticket (status idea, or triaged = dispatchable now). Returns it plus `possible_duplicates` (similar titles; the create still happens, you decide). `claim_seconds` also claims it and returns a claim_token.

status.description: Initial status. `triaged` skips the inbox so sea_next can hand the ticket out immediately.

claim_seconds.description: Also claim the new ticket for this many seconds and return the token.

idempotency_key.description: Replay-safe: a repeat with the same key returns the first result, writes nothing.

actor_id.description: Acting actor (default: the server --actor). Subagents sharing one server pass their own.

tools.name: sea_get
tools.title: Read one ticket
tools.description: One ticket by id or ≥8-char prefix: fields, row_version, claim holder and expiry (never the token), links with the peer's title/status, recent notes, legal_next.

actor_id.description: Acting actor (default: the server --actor). Subagents sharing one server pass their own.

tools.name: sea_list
tools.title: List and search tickets
tools.description: Filter by status (default: non-terminal), kind, priority, assignee ("me" / "none"), tag, claim state and/or full-text `query`. This project unless `project` says otherwise. Cursor-paginated; view compact (default) omits bodies.

status.description: Only these statuses. Default: every non-terminal status.

include_terminal.description: When no status filter is given, also return terminal tickets.

assignee.description: Exact assignee; "me" means the calling actor; "none" means unassigned.

query.description: Full-text search over title and body (FTS5; words are OR-ed).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page.

project.description: Default: this server's project (plus legacy tickets without one). Another project key, or "*" for every project.

actor_id.description: Acting actor (default: the server --actor). Subagents sharing one server pass their own.

budget_truncated.description: The response byte budget ended this page before limit; next_cursor continues.

tools.name: sea_history
tools.title: Chain history for a ticket, or a feed
tools.description: With ticket_id: its chain events (and links touching it), oldest first. Without: every sea event after since_seq — poll it to watch the queue. `verify` (default true) rechecks every hash.

ticket_id.description: Events for one ticket (its own events and links touching it).

since_seq.description: Feed mode: every sea event with seq greater than this.

verify.description: Also recompute every hash in the chain and report the result.

actor_id.description: Acting actor (default: the server --actor). Subagents sharing one server pass their own.

truncated.description: More events follow: call again with since_seq = last_seq.

budget_truncated.description: The response byte budget, not limit, ended this page.

tools.name: sea_scope_check
tools.title: Check paths against claim scopes
tools.description: Would editing these paths collide with a live scope someone else holds (another actor, or you in another session)? Returns {ok, conflicts} naming holder, ticket, overlap and expiry. Needs no claim; your own scopes never conflict.

paths.description: Files or globs you are about to edit (repo-relative).

actor_id.description: Acting actor (default: the server --actor). Subagents sharing one server pass their own.

tools.name: sea_stats
tools.title: Per-actor claim accounting
tools.description: Per actor, from the chain: claims taken / rotated / released / expired / force-released, lease-seconds held, transitions, tickets created, live claims. `since`: 24h, 7d or ISO time. scope_conflict refusals are not counted.

since.description: Window start: a duration back from now (`24h`, `7d`, `2w`) or an ISO-8601 timestamp. Default: the whole chain.

actor_id.description: Acting actor (default: the server --actor). Subagents sharing one server pass their own.

since.description: Window start, or null for the whole chain.
